result.summary:
Realtime track, close-out round 3, fix round 2. Picked up after the 15:37Z session restart. The detached baseA job was not touched and finished at 17:04Z. On top of the earlier fixes (v1–v3, v5–v7, v9, v11, already in the tree) this pass added:

(a) The geometric half of v4. ground.js `liveBridges` exposes the current solids of docked or moving bridges, using `gates.js solids`, `extension` and `boxHitsAc`, so no bridges-track change is needed. Draft request C3F2.2 is withdrawn. app.js and the harness set it as `traffic.liveBridgeAt`. traffic.js `ctlGround` stops a moving body before it enters another stand's bridge (counter `bridgeVeto`, event `bridge-veto`). `GroundPhysics.valid` (`liveHit`) rejects an off-stand parking pose that lies inside such a bridge. `ownBridge` leaves out the body's own stand, a removed occupant's bridge, and a bridge retracting ahead of this arrival. A silent occupant's docked bridge still counts as an obstacle.

(b) The G8 bisect, done with short window replays. The +788 `overlap.gnd` frames come from js/aircraft/types.js alone, i.e. the aircraft track's corrected 737 tailplane: 191 frames with root_after8's types.js on root_ver, 978 with its own. The realtime cause: an arrival drove into G8 through a silent occupant that SFO's 6-h-old plan still listed there (`keeps`). Fixed: ground.js lets `into` (the arrival whose approach retracted that bridge) override `keeps`.

(c) v8. A body dead-reckoned more than 5 s past its last report now brakes (`DR_BRAKE_S`) when a building is within its stopping distance plus 1.5 m. `planPts` now also samples the engine inlets.

Before = the start-of-round code on the verifier's root_ver (A = new fx2/baseA, B = verB, C = verC). After = fx2/root_f3, identical to the repo (traffic 42937590, ground cd2b4965, invariants 2f6c5d9b). All three full segments were re-run. The section 'Round 3, fix round 2' is appended to docs/requests/realtime_closeout.md (line 629), and docs/research/realtime_impl.md Step 10 has items 1–15. The code was already committed in the lead's WIP commit 516a3f9; only the closeout doc is uncommitted.

dispositions.evidence: The 'no push' cancel now re-docks after EARLY_MAX_MS 60 min whatever the transponder does (unless SFO lists an off-block within 15 min; hard cap 75 min). New harness class bridge.signalled_long. Longest signalled retraction: A 404.0 -> 60.0 min (none over 60.0; 12 end at the bound; >75 min 7 -> 0), B 87.5 -> 60.0, C 47.8 -> 47.8. DAL2635 C10: 404 min (off-block) -> 60.0 min (cancel). bridge.signalled_long is 0 on A, B and C.

planKnows(o) is now required for 'alloc', and SFO's arrival stand counts only if planAt(occupant) is false. On the verifier's window (hook_ahead, 4 Nov 19:15-21:12Z) retractions drop 7 -> 1; the one left is ANZ8 G7, a geometric 'close' case at an occupant that had left. Segment A bridge-ahead 100 -> 74; re-docked 'arrival gone' 29 -> 3.

replacedBy/hideFor: the newcomer waits hidden (90 s at most) while the ghost's bridge retracts. Window 5 Nov 04:12-04:22Z with 4.6 h warm-up: UAL29D G13 bridge.hit.fus 262 -> 0, orphan 62 -> 0. Segment A bridge.hit.fus 762/10 -> 487/8; all of the remainder is bridge.hit_at_rest (rest cabs at stand poses, e.g. CSN659 A5), not retractions.

Two parts. (1) At a contact stand, wander that is not backward is held as noise (fwdWanderHeld A 66, B 23, C 27). (2) The guard the verifier asked for: no moving body enters another stand's docked or moving bridge (ctlGround veto on the current gates.js solids via ground.js liveBridges), and no off-stand parking pose is accepted inside one (GroundPhysics.liveHit). Segment C bridge.hit.wing 1,067/2 -> 29/1; A and B were 0/0 and stay 0. UAL875 window 1,136 -> 0 frames. The C residual is UAL1881's own E8 bridge (k 0.48) at a re-in-block, 29 frames. lag.gnd_30m: A +662 frames (0.8 %), B +0, C +68.

The blockout branch is documented as dead in practice: 0 stale-blockout events on A, B and C. Evidence before contact is now 'alloc' from a plan newer than the occupant (v2) and, after 8 h, standRealloc (v11). bridge.orphan A 15,752/76 -> 16,460/67 (part of the increase comes from item 13: overlaps traded for seconds of retracting bridge), B 2,960/19 -> 2,930/18, C 1,102/12 -> 1,102/12. The contact-removal trade-off is documented.

A lock taken at the type's stop now moves the parked pose there (lockAtStop A 28, B 7, C 9). Lock-to-park distance on A: >6 m 444 -> 17 sample-min, >8 m 311 -> 16, max 60.69 -> 14.67 m. C: >6 m 340 -> 0. EVA008 G13 window: 11.57 -> 1.29 m. B residual: a3c3e6 at F17, 8.69 m for 10 min, unchanged because it is not a lock at the stop.

Root cause: B5S shares B5's bridges, so updatePark gave a silent docking the last report 60 m back and the drive ran back to it. Now it parks at the stop pose, with no inferred push during a silent dock. A gnd.reverse 274/10 -> 84/8: EIN961 91 -> 0, UAL892 99 -> 0.

The veto now samples the fuselage sides every 3 m or less and the engine inlets. Dead reckoning more than 5 s past the last report brakes for a building within the stopping distance (drBrake A 396, B 195, C 416). building: C 208/1 -> 0/0 (SWA496 gone), B 519/2 -> 337/1 (SWA1083 gone), A 113/1 -> 113/1. Two data-following taxi wing residuals remain: A UAL1757 B789, 3 wing samples, 113 frames; B AMX664 B39M, 1 sample, 337 frames.
invariants.mjs applyGate passes {freighter} (lookup.js isFreighter), as app.js does.

The fix belongs in the engine-owned js/three/renderer3.js and is filed as request C3F2.1 in realtime_closeout.md: call this.onFatal?.(html) from fatal(). The app side (R.onFatal -> ui.fail) is in place.

This is the finding's own suggested fix: PARK_KEEP_STAND_MS 24 h, plus standRealloc after 8 h (SFO puts a later window on the stand, from a plan newer than the ghost's last report). No silence in the recording reaches 24 h (longest 23.8 h) and A's plan snapshots predate the silences, so the replay shows no change: false-keep 9.6 (+1.0) -> 9.6 (+1.0) aircraft-h. Removed and heard back: A 1/76 -> 1/76, B 0 -> 0, C 1/66 -> 1/66.

open_questions: Should a docked bridge also block a body whose pose comes from data that really drives through it? Today a body stopped at a bridge waits until the 40 m lag rule re-places it. A and B never triggered the veto; C triggered it 15 times. The owner may prefer a faster fade re-placement.

v8 residuals: two taxiing wings follow their data with a wingtip over a footprint edge (A UAL1757 B789 at (-1421, 239); B AMX664 B39M at (-1328, 535)). Either the integration footprints there include something low that a wing may legally overhang, or the drawn pose is ~1 m off. This needs the integration track's footprint provenance; it is not guessed here.
